lines: Your ashes did what I hoped, and now I dare ask for more.
You again. Good. The ashes were only the beginning.
Back so soon? Sit. There is a larger errand, and I need someone who returns.
{~approval}. You came back with the ashes. Now there's something else I need.
The ashes have cooled, but my questions haven't. Have you time for another errand?
